semantic_adjudication.reason: NL5 ('where the cooking time is displayed and updated') requires an effect on entry to ReadytoCook via the Time_Set-triggered transitions. The exact bound carriers transition:line:24 and transition:line:26 both show effects:[] in inspection_equivalent_facts and the raw source has no effect syntax, so the semantic obligation is established against these exact carriers. However, because the closed FCSTM notation never encodes effects for any transition in the model (a uniform representational limitation), a competent alternative reading is that behavior is implemented outside the tracked effect field; this alternative is not excluded by any exact fact in the dossier, so it survives as an undercutting defeater.
semantic_adjudication.strongest_defeater: The FCSTM textual notation for this model only records event triggers and never encodes effects/actions anywhere, so the effect-free syntax on transition:line:24 and transition:line:26 may reflect a uniform representation limitation of the notation rather than a targeted omission of the display/update behavior specifically on this transition.
semantic_adjudication.violated_obligation: NL5 requires the Time_Set-triggered transition into ReadytoCook (from DoorOpenWithItem or DoorShutWithItem) to carry an effect that displays and updates the cooking time.

contracts.quote: remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed
contracts.reason: Explicit self-loop retention alternative on Cancel action from DoorShut.

contracts.basis: NL1: 'transition to the DoorOpen state when the door is opened'.

binding_hints.reason: DoorShut is the origin of this transition.
DoorOpen is the destination of this transition.

contracts.quote: transition to the DoorOpen state when the door is opened
contracts.reason: Explicit endpoint from DoorShut to DoorOpen on door-opened event.

contracts.basis: NL2: 'The door can be closed to return to the DoorShut state.'

binding_hints.reason: DoorOpen is the origin state described as 'In the DoorOpen state'.

contracts.normative_statement: DoorOpenWithItem must have a transition back to DoorOpen triggered by item removal.

contracts.reason: Explicit second alternative endpoint from DoorOpenWithItem to ReadytoCook.

Termination is not explicitly stated in any segment, so no termination contract is created despite Cooking/DoorShut-like naming.
